description: A quoted mixed-case function name and the unquoted name of the same letters are two functions, as PostgreSQL keeps them: "Label"() and label() each keep their own return type, "Scale"($1) and scale($1) type their placeholder from their own argument, "Series"() and series() give their own columns, a call of "Purge"() writes while one of purge() only reads, and a body calling purge() stays read-only. An unquoted LABEL() folds to label().
